title: How to Send Money to M-Pesa in Kenya in 5 Easy Steps
summary: Follow this 5-step guide to safely send money to M-Pesa accounts in Kenya—fast, secure, and hassle-free.
body_markdown:
**If you support your loved ones by[sending money](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/kenya/partners?utm_source=content_marketing&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=blog) to an M-Pesa account, you’re like many of your fellow Africans abroad.**


**Kenyan workers overseas send[millions](https://www.centralbank.go.ke/diaspora-remittances/) of dollars home each year.[Remittances](https://www.remitly.com/blog/immigration/why-remittance-matters/) like yours are an important part of the national economy. However, steep wire transfer fees and lopsided exchange rates can make sending money to Kenya expensive. That’s where[Remitly](https://remitly.onelink.me/94Wt/p44y7u04) comes in.**


## Sending Money to M-Pesa in 5 Easy Steps


Trying to send funds to family and friends in Kenya? Follow[these simple steps](https://help.remitly.com/s/article/how-to-send-a-transfer?language=en_US) to send money safely to an M-Pesa wallet.


1. For first-time users,[download the Remitly app](https://remitly.onelink.me/94Wt/p44y7u04) and create an account. Then select Kenya as your destination country.
2. Enter the amount you wish to send.
3. Select your delivery speed, then choose **Mobile Money** as your delivery method and **M-Pesa** as your location.
4. Enter your recipient’s phone number and full name.
5. Enter your payment details.


And that’s it! Give your details a quick review and press send. Rest easy knowing your money is on its way across borders.


Your recipient can track the transfer on their end, too. Remitly offers peace of mind for everyone involved.


## Why Should I Use Remitly to Send Money to M-Pesa?


With Remitly, it’s super-easy to send money any time and any place using your phone or computer. Our service is very fast. We also offer[excellent exchange rates](https://www.remitly.com/blog/finance/how-to-get-the-best-exchange-rate-when-you-send-money-internationally/) for Kenya and **ZERO transfer fees** .


Plus, if you need to cancel your transfer for any reason, you will get your money back.


## How Quickly Will My Money Arrive?


Using Remitly, sending money to M-Pesa is quick and efficient. Senders that pay with a debit or credit card can transfer money immediately.


If you’re not in a hurry, transfers via bank account take three to five days.


## How Much Money Can I Send to M-Pesa with Remitly?


Remitly is dedicated to helping all of its customers send money safely, no matter the quantity they send. We prioritize safety and international regulations to protect your information and your assets.


To follow those rules, Remitly does have[sending limits](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/help/article/sending-limits?utm_source=content_marketing&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=blog) based on the information provided by a customer.


## Is It Safe to Send to M-Pesa with Remitly?


In a word: yes. There’s a reason that we have millions of users around the world who trust Remitly.


Remitly uses two-factor verification and personal data encryption to ensure safe logins and secure transactions. You can also turn on SMS/text notifications to keep an eye on your transfer.


If anything goes wrong while sending funds, you’ll get your money back.


**[Read more about how Remitly keeps you safe in our guide here.](https://www.remitly.com/blog/finance/is-remitly-safe/)**


## Why Kenyans Love M-Pesa


M-Pesa is Africa’s most successful mobile money service. Similar to Apple Pay, the M-Pesa app allows users to store money on their phones securely and use it to pay bills, send and receive funds, and more.


Users like M-Pesa because it’s so convenient. Like other[mobile money](https://www.remitly.com/blog/finance/how-to-do-international-mobile-money-transfers-mobile-wallet-guide/) providers, it turns your phone into a digital wallet. In a country like Kenya, where the majority of the population does not have a formal bank account, an e-wallet like M-Pesa is a lifesaver.


In fact, in Kenya, the service is so popular that[96%](https://www.vox.com/future-perfect/21420357/kenya-mobile-banking-unbanked-cellphone-money) of the country has a mobile money account. You can use M-Pesa for cashless transactions but also to get cash by going to an agent at an M-Pesa counter.


While M-Pesa doesn’t allow money transfers outside of Kenya, by using[Remitly](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/kenya/pricing?utm_source=content_marketing&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=blog) , you can easily transfer money from outside the country into an M-Pesa mobile wallet.


## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)


### Can I send money directly to an M-Pesa account from abroad?


Yes. Remitly lets eligible customers send money from supported countries directly to a recipient’s M-Pesa mobile wallet in Kenya. During your transfer, select **Mobile Money** as the delivery method and **M-Pesa** as the delivery location.


### What information do I need to send money to M-Pesa?


You’ll typically need your recipient’s full name and the Kenyan phone number associated with their M-Pesa account. You’ll also need to provide your payment details and any information Remitly requires to process and verify the transfer. Double-check the recipient information before sending to help avoid delays.


### How long does it take to send money to M-Pesa with Remitly?


Delivery time depends on factors such as your payment method and the transfer option available to you. Transfers paid for by debit or credit card may arrive quickly, while transfers funded through a bank account can take longer. Review the estimated delivery time shown by Remitly before confirming your transfer.


### How much money can I send to an M-Pesa account?


Remitly applies sending limits based on factors including the information provided by the sender and applicable regulations. M-Pesa may also have limits that affect how much a recipient can receive or hold. Check the limits displayed for your transfer before sending.


### Are there fees for sending money to M-Pesa?


Transfer fees can vary depending on where you’re sending from, your payment method, the amount, and available promotions. Remitly shows the applicable fee, exchange rate, and expected recipient amount before you confirm your transfer, so you can review the total cost in advance.


### What exchange rate will I get when sending money to Kenya?


Exchange rates can change over time and may vary depending on your transfer details. Remitly displays the exchange rate that applies to your transaction and the amount your recipient is expected to receive in Kenyan shillings before you send.


### Is it safe to send money to M-Pesa with Remitly?


Remitly uses security measures designed to protect customer accounts and transactions, including data encryption and account verification. You can also track your transfer and enable notifications to stay informed about its status.
